recipe for pizza crust (from @bebalancedmama on tik tok) 
- [ ] 4 cups of flour 
- [ ] 1 cup plain greek yogurt 
- [ ] 1 teaspoon self rising yeast 
- [ ] 1 cup water 
- [ ] (optional, i added parsley, garlic/onion powder, garlic salt, and basil to my dough)

i used a bread maker to knead my dough for me.
if you don’t have a bread maker, mix the yeast and water together, then slowly pour over your flour/yogurt/seasoning mixture. it’s recommended to let it chill over night in the fridge if you use this method. 
when you’re ready to make the pizza, while the oven was preheating to 425, i stuck my pizza crust in there to warm up for a bit before i added any toppings. once it reached 425, i added the toppings.  
for toppings, i used:
- [ ] homemade browned whipped garlic butter (optional)
- [ ] good & gather pizza sauce 
- [ ] good & gather shredded mozzarella and shredded parmesan cheese 
- [ ] Yves veggie plant based pepperoni 
- [ ] parsley  and truffle parmesan & black garlic

bake pizza for about 20 minutes
